PRIVACY POLICY

4.1 GENERAL

The use of our websites is generally possible without providing personal data. However, insofar as personal data (e.g. names, e-mail addresses) is collected on our website, this data is disclosed on a voluntary basis. Your personal data is collected and processed in accordance with the provisions of German data protection law. The personal data will not be passed on to third parties without your express consent. We would like to point out that data transmission on the Internet (e.g. when communicating by e-mail) can have security gaps. A complete protection of the data against access by third parties is not possible.

items.title: About
items.description: Inspired by the fallibility of memory, both digital and analogue, queer theory, and the impact of physical spaces, they create works that evoke the indefinable aesthetics of memory.
items.bodyHtml:
Auratyk is an audio-visual artist whose work explores the space between nostalgia, folklore, digital hauntology, and the impact of physical spaces.

With a background in music, both performance and production, they have developed a distinctive body of work that is overtly visual, while grounded in and driven by sound.

Inspired by our obsession with a perfect past, folklore, and the impact of the spaces we inhabit, they create works teasing the threshold between the digital and the organic that evoke the indefinable aesthetics of the fallibility of memory — both digital and analogue.

They base their creations in glittery particle systems, using techniques such as point clouds, volumetric video and found footage to create distant but familiar landscapes. These are animated by glitchy, granulated sounds, both inspired and derived from the spaces they inhabit.
